operating_notes.text: CRISIL reaffirmed long-term bank facilities of ₹5,600 Cr at CRISIL BBB/Watch Negative.
India Ratings placed short-term bank facilities of ₹500 Cr on Rating Watch with Developing Implications.
Board approved surrender of Amelia North and Bandha North coal mines.
JAL signed a share sale and purchase agreement to sell 1,64,48,30,118 JPVL shares (24%) to Adani Power for ₹2,993.59 Cr under the NCLT-approved resolution plan.
IDBI Trusteeship released 1,30,26,97,997 equity shares (19.01% of JPVL) comprising 1,20,05,09,431 pledged shares and 10,21,88,566 non-disposal undertaking shares pursuant to NCLT order and JLM.

timeline.summary: Jaiprakash Associates Limited, promoters of Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited, declared no new encumbrances on shareholding in FY2025-26 beyond prior disclosures.
CRISIL reaffirmed its CRISIL BBB/Watch Negative rating on Jaiprakash Power Ventures' ₹5,600 Cr long-term bank facilities.
On April 24, 2026, India Ratings placed Jaiprakash Power Ventures' ₹500 Cr short-term bank facilities on Rating Watch with Developing Implications.
On May 16, 2026, JP Power's board approved the surrender of Amelia North and Bandha North coal mines due to regulatory changes and viability concerns.

On 23 May 2026, JPVL disclosed that promoter Jaiprakash Associates signed a share sale and purchase agreement on 20 May 2026 to sell its 24% JPVL stake (1,64,48,30,118 shares) to Adani Power for ₹2,993.59 Cr, under the NCLT-approved resolution plan.
On 21 May 2026, IDBI Trusteeship released the 19.01% pledge and non-disposal undertaking on JPVL shares held by Jaiprakash Associates.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,512.12 Cr (+5.1% YoY), net profit ₹33.34 Cr (-81.7% YoY).
